items.evidence: Phase 9 baseline: all ICs <= 0.02. Phase 10 ablation: no feature family carries identifiable incremental signal.
Phase 10: ridge improved from -0.0003 to +0.0202, lasso to +0.0312. But RF IC DECREASED from +0.0119 to -0.018. Best returns came from removing features (FS-009 ALL-momentum: +221%).
Phase 12A: modest improvement in some configs. Universe-dependent. No convincing incremental value.
Phase 12D/12E: lasso with leverage/earnings features produced ICs 0.034-0.043. Below 0.05 threshold. Inconsistent across universes. Partially implemented.
Linear mean IC = 0.0147, nonlinear mean IC = -0.0038. Sign reversal, not merely degradation. RF/XGB consistently produce negative or near-zero ICs.

items.assumption: OHLCV features contain robust predictive signal
items.evidence: Phase 9: all 20 ML runs had |OOS IC| <= 0.02, hit rates 0.51-0.54. Best ML (+127%) below best control (+205%).
Phase 10: removing features helped more than adding them. FS-009 (ALL-momentum) and FS-013 (ALL-range) outperformed FS-003 (ALL).
Phase 12.9C: linear mean IC = +0.0147, nonlinear mean IC = -0.0038. Trees reverse the direction of the effect.
Phase 11: signal dilution on larger universes. 4 sign reversals, 8 magnitude collapses across universes.
Phase 13A: effect absent or negative in 2022 bear market. IC for 2022 windows consistently negative (-0.031 to -0.068).
Phase 13A: both candidates p~0.20, 95% CI spans zero, fail Holm correction. Effect sizes moderate (Cohen's d ~0.5) but underpowered at n=8 windows.
Mean IC 0.018-0.027 below 0.05 academic threshold. No Sharpe, turnover, or capacity evidence. Portfolio validation entirely absent.

universe_dependent.description: 4 sign reversals and 8 magnitude collapses when comparing across universes

regime_dependent.description: Effect absent in 2022 bear/high-volatility regime, appears only in 2023-2025
regime_dependent.evidence: Phase 13A sequential windows: 2022 ICs negative, 2023-2025 positive

model_family_dependent.description: Effect strictly linear-only. Trees reverse direction.

economically_weak.description: IC 0.018-0.027 below 0.05 academic threshold. No portfolio test.

statistically_weak.description: p~0.20, CI spans zero, fails Holm correction
statistically_weak.evidence: Phase 13A inference: CAND-03 p=0.216, CAND-04 p=0.200

perturbation_sensitive.description: CAND-04 sign-flips at 5% feature noise. CAND-03 collapses at 10%.

items.description: How returns arrive within a window (path smoothness, max drawdown, up/down ratio, largest move). Captures temporal dynamics that levels miss.
items.novelty: HIGH — existing features capture only total return over a window, not the path taken
items.overlap_with_existing: LOW — path features are orthogonal to levels and ratios

items.description: Skewness, kurtosis, downside volatility of return distributions within a window.
items.novelty: HIGH — existing features are symmetric (mean, std). Skewness captures asymmetry.
items.overlap_with_existing: LOW — skewness is orthogonal to level and volatility features

items.description: Vol-of-vol, volatility regime transitions, volatility change rates. Not just levels.
items.data_source: OHLCV bars (derived from existing vol features)
items.novelty: MEDIUM — existing vol_ratio_10_30 captures some regime info, but vol-of-vol is genuinely new

items.description: Fed Funds Rate level and changes, unemployment rate, CPI inflation. Macro context that conditions all stock-level signals.
items.novelty: HIGH — no existing feature uses macro data
items.overlap_with_existing: NONE — macro data is completely untested

items.description: First-order autocorrelation of returns within a window. Captures momentum vs mean-reversion dynamics.
items.novelty: LOW — likely redundant with momentum features
items.overlap_with_existing: HIGH — autocorrelation is closely related to momentum

summary.strongest_effect_assessment: Below 0.05 academic threshold. Inconsistent across universes. Not statistically significant.
summary.canonical_conclusion: No convincing, robust predictive relationship has been established.
summary.primary_bottleneck: All tested features are levels or simple ratios of price/volume/fundamentals. No temporal dynamics, path structure, asymmetry, or macro regime information has been tested.
summary.recommended_next_direction: Test genuinely new information domains: path structure, return asymmetry, volatility dynamics, and macro regime conditioning.
